messages.text: lol, just looking at the shipping for the miner Abel sent me a couple of weeks ago. I think I should get it here by the end of this week.
Happy to check that for you. What's the order number, and either the name it ships to or the postcode?
That order number isn't matching anything on my side. What's the name it ships to? I've got the (address hidden) zip, I just need the name to pull the right one.
its ok, I know its on the way. Sorry to leave you hanging there. Been busy with a prototype I'm building for you. (tracking link hidden)

No worries. That tracking matches the free unit Abel sent out, it left on the 22nd with Yun Express. There's no delivery date posted on it yet, so I can't promise end of week, but the tracking page updates as it moves.

Anything you want me to check on the prototype side while you're here?
I'm ok, just getting all the JLPCB part numbers together so they can assemble it when the time comes.
Before you go, one thing: what made you build your own board rather than start from one of ours?
They contracted me to build. lol must be someone not in the loop or just AI
Fair, I'm the team's automated first line, and a person steps in when it's needed. Should've clocked that one. Good luck with the part list, and ping me here if the tracking stalls.
